title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
protagonist: Jonathan Harker (with Mina and the hunters)

beats.event: Harker travels to Dracula's castle in Transylvania
Encounters three vampire women; learns Dracula's true nature
Dracula sails to England aboard the Demeter
Crew vanishes; ship runs aground at Whitby with dead captain
Lucy sleepwalks and becomes gravely ill
Van Helsing diagnoses blood loss; transfusions and garlic
Lucy rises as vampire, stalking children as 'bloofer lady'
Hunters stake her, behead her, fill her mouth with garlic
Dracula attacks Mina, drinking her blood
Forces Mina to drink his blood, cursing her
Group discovers Dracula's boxes of earth across London
Sterilize most boxes; fail to trap him at Piccadilly
Use Mina's psychic link under hypnosis to track him
Harker decapitates him; Morris stakes the heart
Dracula destroyed; Mina freed from the curse
